fun plan(pr: String): Verdict {
    val scope = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/scope.json")
    val changedFiles = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/changed-files.txt")
    val taskContext = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
    val diff = readDiff(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/pr.diff")
    val repoContext = readFile(path = ".repo_context/README.md")
    val contextIndex = readFile(path = ".repo_context/index.md")
    val maintenance = readFile(path = ".repo_context/maintenance.md")
    val generatedIndex = readFile(path = ".repo_context/generated/repo_index.md")
    val principles = readFile(path = ".repo_context/modules/overview/engineering-principles.md")
    val reviewPlaybook = readFile(path = ".repo_context/playbooks/reviews/pr-review-checklist.md")
    val selfVerify = readFile(path = ".repo_context/playbooks/upkeep/ai-self-verification.md")
    val docs = search(query = "dscli OR disk OR data_dir OR cli", path = ".")
    val commandSource = readFile(path = "cli/command.py")
    val dscliDoc = readFile(path = "docs/source_zh_cn/deployment/dscli.md")
    val readme = readFile(path = "README.md")
    val packaging = search(query = "packages OR entry_points OR dscli OR cli", path = ".")
    val findings = analyzeDocs(scope, changedFiles, taskContext, diff, repoContext, contextIndex, maintenance, generatedIndex, principles, reviewPlaybook, selfVerify, docs, commandSource, dscliDoc, readme, packaging)
    val verdict = makeVerdict(findings)
    writeFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", value = verdict)
    return verdict
}
